descriptionByLocale.it: We’re a looking for an Institutional (Hedge Fund focused) FX salesperson, Americas to: - Develop and maintain strong relationships with institutional clients, including hedge funds and asset managers. Someone with strong existing relationships with clients. - Drive revenue growth by actively selling a variety of FX products including spot Fx, NDF’s Swaps, Vanilla Options; Exotic options including, RKO’s. Digitals, Dual Digitals; Correaltion Swaps; Worst of Options; Window Knock out options and other exotics. - Partner with the trading desk and research teams to provide market insights, generate actionable trade ideas, and present investment opportunities to clients. - Collaborate and work with the Global FX trading business to drive and grow our institutional FX franchise.
